source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The migrated Open, Delete, Open in Folder and Save as Search Folder buttons put id before data-l10n-id and command. Keep this accepted local order when working in that button group. It is a scoped markup convention, not a global attribute-order requirement or proof that whitespace lint passed. Unrelated controls and files keep their own local contracts.
title: Search Messages puts id first in its migrated action buttons
